title: eMRTD differential harness
description: Differential test harness for open-source eMRTD reader libraries. Identical synthetic chip profiles are replayed against multiple stacks; each run captures APDU traces and classifies whether negotiation failures or specification-permitted downgrades reach a typical application caller (Observability Score). Synthetic APDU profiles only; not RF / silicon. Cite SemVer tag v1.0.7. Locked full-run trees: Release asset emrtd-locked-runs-v1.0.7.zip.
notes: When the Computers & Security (C&S / CoSe) manuscript receives a DOI, add it here as related_identifiers with relation isDocumentedBy. Mint Zenodo only from emrtd-locked-runs-v1.0.7.zip on Release v1.0.7.
